name: Latent Factor Matrix Factorization Dot Product Recommendation
description: Matrix factorization (SVD / ALS) maps users and movies to latent factor vectors. Predicted rating is dot product of user vector and movie vector plus user and movie bias terms.
prompt:
Matrix factorization (SVD / ALS) maps users and movies to latent factor vectors. Predicted rating is dot product of user vector and movie vector plus user and movie bias terms.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: user_id, movie_id, title, predicted_rating.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Predict user rating: baseline (3.5) + u_bias + m_bias + (u_vec . m_vec)
            SELECT 
                u.user_id,
                m.movie_id,
                m.title,
                ROUND(
                    3.5 + u.user_bias + m.movie_bias + array_inner_product(u.u_vec, m.m_vec), 2
                ) AS predicted_rating
            FROM user_latent u
            CROSS JOIN item_latent m
            WHERE u.user_id = 1
            ORDER BY predicted_rating DESC;
why_it_fails: Omitting bias terms causes popular movies to be underrated and niche items to be overrated.
